title: Weight Limit
blurb: The bridge holds under 300, but the goats Marcus let loose got there first. Write the inequality, undo it in two steps, and when you divide by a negative, the Turnbats turn the sign over. Check it with a number.
note: Captions stay on. It opens on the cracking bridge, then goes back four minutes. Pause after Marcus says "Two goats off!" and ask whether two is enough: check it with a number. When the Turnbats fly up, ask which way the sign should point. At the end, read the number line together: more than three.
